# Erasure fixture provenance

The twelve JSON files under `tiny/` and `full/` are unchanged copies of
`erasure/{tiny,full}/ec-*.json` from
[davxy/jam-test-vectors v0.8.0](https://github.com/davxy/jam-test-vectors/tree/d3c089c9a1d5352ad353626d7a2db8589f137b2a/erasure),
commit `d3c089c9a1d5352ad353626d7a2db8589f137b2a`.

The upstream CC0 1.0 Universal license is copied to `LICENSE`.
GP 0.8.0 Tiny uses three original shards and three recovery shards; Full
uses 342 original shards and 681 recovery shards.

These are test inputs only. Production recovery never reads fixtures.
